WITH base AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN source_stream LIKE 'cbc%' AND raw_event_type = 'endpoint.event.netconn' THEN 'network connection/listen'
      WHEN event_id IN (5154,5158) OR access IN ('connect','listen') THEN 'network connection/listen'
      WHEN source_stream LIKE 'cbc%' AND childproc_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'child process'
      WHEN source_stream LIKE 'cbc%' AND (alert_name IS NOT NULL OR alert_reason IS NOT NULL OR alert_category IS NOT NULL) THEN 'CBC alert'
      WHEN access IN ('read','write','create','delete') THEN 'file read/write/create/delete'
      WHEN source_stream = 'msft-security' AND event_id IN (4656,4663,4658) THEN 'Security execute/object access'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS category,
    CASE
      WHEN source_stream LIKE 'cbc%' AND raw_event_type = 'endpoint.event.netconn' THEN COALESCE(access,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(remote_ip,'') || ':' || COALESCE(remote_port,'')
      WHEN event_id IN (5154,5158) OR access IN ('connect','listen') THEN COALESCE(access,'') || ' ' || COALESCE(object,'')
